name: standing bend alternating toe touch
description: A quick standing toe touch where you reach to opposite feet in turn, warming up the hamstrings and midsection.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet wider than your hips and arms out to the sides.
Hinge forward and twist to reach one hand toward the opposite foot.
Return to standing with arms out.
Reach the other hand to the opposite foot.
Keep a flat back and move at a lively pace.
